title: 'Fuun kara no Saikyou Otoko' Reveals Main Staff, 2027 Debut
content: Production company Asmik Ace opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Fukufuku 's Fuun kara no Saikyou Otoko ( The Strongest Man, Born from Misfortune ) light novel on Tuesday, revealing the main staff, the image song, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Yuki Kodama's Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content: NHK announced on Tuesday that it is producing a live-action series of Yuki Kodama 's Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori (Blue Flower, Forest of Vessels) manga that will premiere on NHK 's "Yorudora" programming block this fall.
author: ANN

title: Chainsmoker Cat Anime Gets Uncut 'Evil Dragon Unleashed' Version
content: The official website for the television anime of Nyan Nyan Factory 's Chainsmoker Cat ( Yanineko ) manga announced on Tuesday that the anime will have two versions, an "Evil Dragon Unleashed" version that "respects the work's directorial intent" on some of the episodes, and an "On-Air" version that is made for…
author: ANN

title: 'The Strongest Man, Born From Misfortune' Anime Reveals Teaser Image, 2027 Debut, Staff
content: The staff of the anime adaptation of Fukufuku 's The Strongest Man, Born From Misfortune ( Fuun kara no Saikyō Otoko ) light novel series revealed a teaser image, four staff members, and 2027 debut on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Shakugan no Shana: Blaze Edge Browser Game Reveals Gameplay Video
content: CTW Inc. revealed on Monday the gameplay video for Shakugan no Shana : Blaze Edge , its browser game based on Yashichiro Takahashi 's Shakugan no Shana light novel series. The video reveals new voice lines for the character Shana, who is voiced by Rie Kugimiya .
author: ANN

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Studio’s Biggest Blunder Gets a New Remake
content: Based on the 2019 manga by Coffee, the anime adaptation of Wandance debuted this year as a collaborative work between Madhouse and Cyclone Graphics. title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Will Be a Huge Disappointment For Fans
content: While the Jujutsu Kaisen manga reached its conclusion in September 2024, the anime still has a long way to go. The third season was confirmed as soon as JJK wrapped up its Shibuya Incident Arc. Season 2 has been a roller coaster of emotions with Gojo’s backstory and the most intense arc in the story so far.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump’s Best Magical Girl Series Confirms New Physical Release Ahead of Season 2
content: Kenta Shinohara’s Weekly Shonen Jump hit series Witch Watch is a refreshing fantasy series set in a modern world where mythological and fantasy creatures have evolved and learned to live among humans.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Heroines Anime's Trailer Unveils Aina the End's Theme Song
content: The official website for the One Piece anime began streaming a trailer video for the anime for writer Jun Esaka and artist Sayaka Suwa 's One Piece Heroines light novel series on Tuesday. The trailer announces and previews the anime's theme song "Blue Shining Star" by singer Aina The End .
author: ANN

title: One Piece Heroines Anime Reveals New Trailer, Theme Song by AiNA THE END
content: A new trailer has been released for ONE PIECE HEROINES , the upcoming TV special based on ONE PIECE novel HEROINES . It was also announced that the theme song will be “Blue Shining Star,” a new track performed by AiNA THE END.
author: Anime Corner
